info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Internal Bank Account Retrieval API
info.description: The Internal Bank Account Retrieval API enables clients to access detailed information about internal bank accounts within the financial system. This endpoint serves as a resource for retrieving account specifics, such as balances, transaction history, and account status, by providing a unique identifier for the account. Typical consumers of this API include financial institution staff, accounting departments, and automated reporting systems requiring account data for analysis and management. By seamlessly integrating this API, organizations can ensure efficient and accurate financial operations.

get.description: Fetches the detailed information of the specified internal bank account using its unique identifier. This operation allows users to obtain all relevant data for account management purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the operational services related to a specific bank account identified by the account number ACC-200045. Ensure that the request contains all necessary fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the internal bank account details.
